# Google Analytics

Google Analytics tracks and reports website traffic, user behavior, and conversion data, enabling marketers to optimize online performance and customer journeys

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/google-analytics/.

## Actions

- **Create Expanded Data Set**: Create an expanded data set for a property.
- **Get Account**: Retrieve a single account by its resource name.
- **List Accounts**: List all accounts accessible by the caller.
- **List Audiences**: List all audiences on a property.
